position: The demo can show source-first answer drafts, but production launch remains gated until evidence, consent, storage, licensing, and reviewer workflows are real.
headline: Evidence before launch confidence.
copy: This gate makes the next founder decision explicit: what is demo-ready, what stays private, and what must wait for real infrastructure.

postures.title: Static demo
postures.copy: Show bounded answer draft rooms and source-first flow.

postures.title: Live AI
postures.copy: No live generation until retrieval, logging, and review contracts exist.

postures.title: Public source corpus
postures.copy: No broad corpus claims until rights and reviewer coverage are documented.

postures.title: Founder review
postures.copy: Use the evidence pack to decide the next build direction.

flow.title: Source
flow.copy: Coverage, family, dossier, and approval are visible.

flow.title: Answer
flow.copy: Draft, revision, and trace are visible.

flow.title: Audience
flow.copy: Beginner, Sanskrit, and scholar views stay separated.

flow.title: Launch
flow.copy: Demo can expand only where risks stay labeled.

decisions.label: Demo surface
decisions.reason: Static pages and local memory are bounded.

decisions.label: Live answer generation
decisions.reason: No production retrieval or reviewer storage yet.

decisions.label: Scholar approval
decisions.reason: Mantra, Sanskrit, and commentary lanes need human review.

decisions.label: Public launch
decisions.reason: Need storage, consent, telemetry, corpus rights, and QA evidence.

locks.title: No hidden telemetry
locks.copy: Learning metrics must begin with consent and local boundaries.

locks.title: No source inflation
locks.copy: No answer may claim more than the source packet supports.

locks.title: No spiritual authority
locks.copy: VedaPath stays a learning companion, not a guru, ritual authority, or clinician.

packet:
VedaPath Launch Evidence Pack v4.5.5
Demo-ready: static source-first answer draft rooms
Blocked: live AI, public corpus, production storage, payment, public launch
Evidence present: source coverage, family map, passage dossier, reviewer approval, answer integration, draft review, revision, trace, audience views
Founder decision: proceed to real Source API Contract before external launch
